author: Codex prepared source-grounded draft; not represented as human-authored
stability_protocol: Use one fixed main analysis. Three independent identical production representation declarations per selected case. Prefer selected spatial/probability compiler; if unavailable use the planner declaration. These are predeclared stability samples, never semantic retries. Preserve rejection outcomes. Three extra declaration requests after the first-pass pipeline; first-pass request not counted among the three.

scoring.PASS: Evidence supports required source semantics and truthful supported behavior.
scoring.PARTIAL: Useful bounded result with identified missing semantics/capability/grounding.
scoring.FAIL: Unusable, invented, unsafe, wrong ownership or materially misleading behavior.
scoring.NOT APPLICABLE: Capability not justified by the source, or a correctly static case. Not a substitute for untested.

fixed_quantities: source example coefficients remain compiled baseline; not measurements
unsupported_semantics: no gravitational orbit or motor torque model
no changing the original source examples
expectations.static_degradation_conditions: A formal/numeric view is correct if a consistent bounded planar world cannot compile.

fixed_quantities: given initial conditions must remain identified as the source baseline
expectations.static_degradation_conditions: Numeric/formal degradation is correct when the runtime cannot express the oscillator honestly.

fixed_quantities: 5 V/0 V examples and boundary conditions are source baselines
unsupported_semantics: no nonlinear transistor or second-order RLC model
expectations.static_degradation_conditions: A formula/table/flow is correct without an unambiguous waveform inverse; generic bounded hypothetical defaults must be labeled.

fixed_quantities: 439 Hz observed bell and plotted recording
adjustable_quantities: hypothetical sine/cosine frequency, amplitude and phase
unsupported_semantics: no exact recovery of the recorded audio/spectrum from the screenshot
no execution of thinkdsp Python or audio download
expectations.static_degradation_conditions: Static descriptions are correct if only measured recordings are modeled or a safe symbolic demo is unsupported.

fixed_quantities: fitted slope -0.0431 and intercept 24.319 in thousands
adjustable_quantities: explicitly hypothetical trial line separate from fitted source coefficients
unsupported_semantics: do not make fitted estimates adjustable without a hypothetical distinction
expectations.static_degradation_conditions: A formal equation and source plot is correct if fixed empirical data cannot be represented; no drag of observed dots.

concepts_present: die outcome sets A={1,2}, B={4,6}, D={2,3}
fixed_quantities: six fair die outcomes and source memberships
adjustable_quantities: Monte Carlo sample count with original probabilities
unsupported_semantics: do not treat dice sums as uniformly likely
no arbitrary changes to source probabilities
no unlimited 52-outcome world if contract exceeds bounds
expectations.static_degradation_conditions: A bounded six-outcome die subset is honest with scope disclosed; other examples may stay formal. Dragging geometry is N/A.

fixed_quantities: source contains no measured timing dataset
adjustable_quantities: explicit hypothetical sorted input only if safely resolved
expectations.static_degradation_conditions: A read-only flow/comparison is correct when bounded execution is unsupported.

adjustable_quantities: positive integer input size n for illustrative operation counts
unsupported_semantics: do not present operation count as measured wall-clock time
expectations.static_degradation_conditions: A comparison/table is sufficient; numeric count curves are optional and must stay illustrative.

fixed_quantities: every source table cell and size comparison
vacuum conversion baseline approximately c=3e8 m/s if explained as general physics
adjustable_quantities: explicitly hypothetical positive wavelength/frequency conversion within numeric limits
unsupported_semantics: no invented full spectrum dataset or new 3D propagation scene
no claimed exact page-box grounding before Atlas validation
expectations.static_degradation_conditions: Static table is correct if numeric dynamic ranges exceed the bounded evaluator. Only physical PDF page 35 is ingested: photo/stock pages are excluded.

unsupported_semantics: no fabricated executable debugger or source code
expectations.static_degradation_conditions: Formal/static representation is the intended success, preserving selection/source navigation without fabricated manipulation.
